Name: All Seeds At Pierre's Shop All Seasons
Author: KaosKuantico
Description:
You can buy any seed at any time of the year at Pierre's Shop. No more season restriction. Since day 1 you can buy any seed you want.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size]

[/b]1. Go to steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/mods
2. Unzip the file inside the Mods folder
3. Done!
